messages:
Priya: Sprint-0 check-in for Optimize toolkit. Need firm priorities on batching heuristics, prefix caching, quant recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Keep replies short please.

Emma: For batching: target is >=15% token cost reduction on pilot workloads. Need p99 latency SLO (propose 200ms).

Oliver: SRE: add canary + rate cap. Risk: cache eviction storms and batch coalescing causing memory peaks.

Jason: Ops: pilot flow = invite-only alpha -> opt-in beta. Need feature flags + telemetry schema synced with Legal.

LegalBot: Flag: telemetry contract addendum required for storing sample-level prompts. Expect +5 business days.

Miguel: Customers want presets: "balancer" (latency-first) and "economizer" (cost-first) and per-route quant suggestions. AcmeHealth wants alpha.

Priya: Draft acceptance criteria: batching: >=15% cost win without p99 > SLO; cache: TTL + invalidation docs, >=99% correctness on cached prefixes; quant recs: recommend per-route with <=3% degradation or easy opt-out; eval alerts: threshold config and slack/email delivery. Any objections?

Emma: No objections. I'll add perf artifact and example configs. Example snippet:
optimize:
  batching:
    strategy: prefix-aware
    max_batch_ms: 8
  cache:
    ttl_secs: 1800
  quant_recommendation:
    granularity: per_route
    safety_margin: 0.03

Oliver: I'll draft rollback hooks + automatic fallback to FP model. Also include trace sampling for cache misses.

Jason: I'll own pilot invite list + feature flagging work. Need Legal sign-off before telemetry goes live.

Miguel: I'll confirm AcmeHealth traffic profile by Friday.

Priya: Timeline: spec PR by Tue, alpha invites Fri, pilot rollout in 2 sprints. I'll post the prioritization matrix after PR. :rocket:
